headline: Berm Boils as Hollow and Expanse Wake Again
war_summary: Morning wires show Palantine Berm quickening to ten changes in two hours and thirty-six in the day around Vendett, the Pippeli Stones and Windburn Landing, holding two Warden, three Colonial and two neutral, while Marban Hollow has stirred anew with three changes in two hours and twenty-three in the day centered on Checkpoint Bua, standing three Warden, four Colonial and one neutral, and Weathered Expanse returns to the ledger with three changes in two hours and nineteen in the day about Spirit Watch and Wightwalk, counting six Warden, one Colonial and two neutral amid day losses above eleven thousand Colonial and thirteen thousand Warden. Nevish Line adds two changes in two hours and eight in the day at Grief Mother, still six Warden to two Colonial with losses above seven thousand Colonial and six thousand Warden. Linn Mercy, by contrast, falls silent in the last two hours after six in six and seventeen in the day at Lathair and Outwich Ranch, now one Warden, nine Colonial and one neutral, while Mooring County and the Gutter remain quiet after twenty-five and three changes in the day respectively.
